notes.interpret-driver: The driver: it does what the flow asks for, and answers with a command.
notes.interpret-flow: Decides how `clp interpret` proceeds: which component to interpret and from what, how sessions and attempts follow each other and when sessions are compared; and for `clp interpret --accept`, which drafts are accepted, round after round.
notes.interpret-flow.does.compared: A later session has been compared (ok or not, it counts as done). The next session starts (pinned), or, after the last one, interpreting finishes as interpreted.
notes.interpret-flow.does.consider: A component, in name order. A component without an interpretation (neither a draft nor an accepted one) is chosen, to be interpreted from a skeleton: its first session starts (attempt 1). A component with one has it checked first.
notes.interpret-flow.does.considerAccepting: A component to accept. Without a draft or an interpretation, it is refused (no-interpretation). If its draft (or, without a draft, its interpretation) has questions or disagreements left open, it is refused (open-reviews). Without a draft, an interpretation whose stamp is already the current Layer 1 needs nothing: the next component is asked for. Otherwise it is checked. Every refusal counts as a component that could not be accepted in this round, and the next component is asked for.
notes.interpret-flow.does.currentChecked: If the current interpretation passed the check, nothing is to be done for this component: the next one is asked for. Otherwise the component is chosen, to be interpreted from its current interpretation (update): its first session starts.
notes.interpret-flow.does.draftChecked: If it passed, it is accepted, which counts as a component accepted in this round; otherwise it is refused (does-not-fit), which counts as one that could not be accepted. The next component is asked for.
notes.interpret-flow.does.endRound: The round is over. If some component could not be accepted and some was accepted in this round (a component that contains another may fit only once the other is accepted), another round runs over those that could not be accepted, starting again with nothing accepted or refused in it. Otherwise accepting is over.
notes.interpret-flow.does.noMoreComponents: Every component's interpretation fits: interpreting finishes as up-to-date.
notes.interpret-flow.does.sessionChecked: An attempt of the running session is over. If it was not ok and attempts remain, the next attempt of the same session starts, in the same mode. If the first session ends without an ok attempt, interpreting finishes as failed. When the first session is ok: with one session, or when it gave no vocabulary (hasModel false), interpreting finishes as interpreted; otherwise the second session starts (attempt 1, pinned). When a later session is ok, it is compared with the first. When a later session ends without an ok attempt, it is recorded as uncompared, and the next session starts (pinned), or, after the last one, interpreting finishes as interpreted.
notes.interpret-flow.does.start: Interpreting starts with the number of sessions and of attempts per session. The first component is asked for.
notes.interpret-flow.does.startAccepting: Accepting starts: a round over every component. The first component is asked for.
